$comment: Throttle controls ONLY the OpenAI Lead tier. It must never decide which consumer model handles EXPLORE / BUILD / VERIFY / DEBUG - that is config/routing.json. `model` references a key in config/models.json; `variant` must be one of that model's declared variants.

low.description: Economical Lead. Best default when cost matters.

mid.description: Stronger Lead reasoning on the same Sol model.

high.description: Premium Lead. Larger context and the stronger reasoning tier.
